name: Sysmon Channel Reference Deletion
description: Potential threat actor tampering with Sysmon manifest and eventually disabling it
author: GAI_CTI
query: winlog.channel:Security AND ((event.code:4657 AND (winlog.event_data.ObjectName:(*WINEVT\\Publishers\\\{5770385f\-c22a\-43e0\-bf4c\-06f5698ffbd9\}* OR *WINEVT\\Channels\\Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational*)) AND winlog.event_data.ObjectValueName:Enabled AND winlog.event_data.NewValue:0) OR (event.code:4663 AND (winlog.event_data.ObjectName:(*WINEVT\\Publishers\\\{5770385f\-c22a\-43e0\-bf4c\-06f5698ffbd9\}* OR *WINEVT\\Channels\\Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational*)) AND winlog.event_data.AccessMask:65536))
